title: Store Update 1.43.0
body:
# Store Update 1.43.0

It's Tuesday, Raiders!

Store Update 1.43.0 is now rolling out, bringing with it the heavy duty Roamer Set! Be sure to restart your game so you're running the latest version.

Shani's investigation into the strange ARC behavior continues...

The Phantom Targets Event is live until **September 06**. Head out and track down those erratic Wasps to collect their strange glitched tech.

Knowledge is essential for survival, and we need to find out what these ARC units are doing, fast. Contributing to the research effort will earn you the Anomalia Outfit, along with the Finger Guns Wave emote, the Trashpile Bag, and Raider Tokens, so you can look the part for what's coming next...

As we keep building on our anti-cheat efforts, we're placing extra focus on linked accounts. If someone else gains access to your account, whether you gave them permission or not, and they get caught cheating, your account can be banned even though you weren't the one who cheated.

To prevent this from happening, now is a good time to make sure your account is properly secured through your login provider (Steam, Sony, Xbox, Epic, etc.):

* Use a strong, unique password

* Enable two-factor authentication

* Never share your login details with anyone

Securing your account helps protect your progress and keeps things fair for everyone playing. Thanks for helping us keep ARC Raiders a great experience for all Raiders.

Submissions for the special Waspy Community Highlights episode are still open! If you've ridden a Wasp through the air, pulled one down to the ground with a Snap Hook, or riled up the swarm by spamming Snitch Scanners, send us your best footage!

We'll select the top 5 clips to feature in this Community Highlights episode, and the winners will receive the Wasp Hunter DLC set!

Details on where to submit your clips are available through our channels.

The ARC Raiders team is heading Topside to Gamescom this week. We're loading up the shuttles with merch and coaxing Scrappy into his travel carrier as we write this. Come by the booth to say hi and pick up some freebies!

See you at the booth or online!
